description: Single-source pre-push gate manifest. The hook at plugins/saga/hooks/pre_push_gate_hook.py reads this file and runs every step in order. Add or remove steps here to change what the gate checks — the hook never diverges.

steps.label: ruff format --check
steps.failure_hint: Run `uv run python -m ruff format .` to auto-fix formatting.

steps.label: ruff check
steps.failure_hint: Run `uv run python -m ruff check --fix .` to apply safe auto-fixes.

steps.label: mypy type check
steps.failure_hint: Run `uv run python -m mypy plugins/ scripts/ tests/ --ignore-missing-imports` and fix the type errors reported above.

steps.label: validate plugin manifests
steps.failure_hint: Fix plugin manifest errors reported above.

steps.label: pytest
steps.failure_hint: Fix failing tests before pushing. The gate runs without coverage instrumentation so the suite fits the hook's 300-second step timeout; CI still runs the full coverage configuration.
